dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「友よ」
dialogues.en:
"I was just surprised by the shock. Quit interpreting
everything to your own advantage."
dialogues.text:
"I was just surprised by the shock. Quit interpreting
everything to your own advantage."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ぬおっ」
dialogues.en: "Why are you so surprised?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you so surprised?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突なエンカウントに、思わずのけ反る。
dialogues.en:
"Because your house is in the opposite direction from my
house. Why are you here?"
dialogues.text:
"Because your house is in the opposite direction from my
house. Why are you here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお、嬉しいなあ！　俺に会えて、そんなに
　喜んでくれるとはっ！」
dialogues.en:
Usually I'll never meet Suginami on the way to or from
school.
dialogues.text:
Usually I'll never meet Suginami on the way to or from
school.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その望遠鏡のような拡大解釈はやめろ……。
　単に驚いただけだろうが」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha!"
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうして驚くのだ？」
dialogues.en: "That's an easy question to answer. I was waiting for you."
dialogues.text: "That's an easy question to answer. I was waiting for you."

dialogues.jp:
通常ならば、杉並とは行きも帰りも一緒にはな
らないのだ。
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha!"
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「決まってる。お前を待ってたんだ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はっはっは」
dialogues.en: "Why are you walking so fast?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you walking so fast?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なあ、朝倉よ」
dialogues.en: "Am I?"
dialogues.text: "Am I?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「何だ？」
dialogues.en: "I was waiting for you, you know."
dialogues.text: "I was waiting for you, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうしてそんなに早足なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha. ...Whew..."
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha. ...Whew..."

dialogues.jp: ため息しいしい、振り返る。
dialogues.en: I look back with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I look back with a sigh.

dialogues.jp:
「お前な、朝っぱらからキモイ事ぬかすな。奥
　歯がたがた言わすぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Stop talking creepy this early in the morning. I will hurt
you."
dialogues.text:
"Stop talking creepy this early in the morning. I will hurt
you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは。ま、お前が寂しがっているかと
　思ってな」
dialogues.en: "Ha-ha-ha! I just thought you must be lonely."
dialogues.text: "Ha-ha-ha! I just thought you must be lonely."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「は？　何で？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「もはやお前の隣には、朝倉妹が居ない」
dialogues.en:
"Because you don't have your little sister beside you any
more."
dialogues.text:
"Because you don't have your little sister beside you any
more."

dialogues.jp: 微妙に図星なので、返す言葉が見当たらない。
dialogues.en: I can't say anything back to him because he's right.
dialogues.text: I can't say anything back to him because he's right.

dialogues.jp:
軽く舌を打ち、正面を見据える。その横に、に
やけ顔の杉並が並んだ。
dialogues.en:
I hiss quietly and look straight ahead. Suginami's walking
right beside me, with a grin on his face.
dialogues.text:
I hiss quietly and look straight ahead. Suginami's walking
right beside me, with a grin on his face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だがな、気を落とす事はないぞ、朝倉。なん
　せ、俺が居るっ！」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so down, Asakura. You have me now!"
dialogues.text: "Don't be so down, Asakura. You have me now!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜……、まあ、なんていうか、たとえて言
　うならアレだ」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... How can I say this. For example, you're like..."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... How can I say this. For example, you're like..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「変身出来ないクラーク・ケント？　芯の切れ
　たシャーペン？　相撲の取れない相撲取り？」
dialogues.en:
"You're like a Clark Kent who can't turn into Superman. Or
should I say you're like a mechanical pencil without lead,
or a sumo wrestler who can't wrestle?"
dialogues.text:
"You're like a Clark Kent who can't turn into Superman. Or
should I say you're like a mechanical pencil without lead,
or a sumo wrestler who can't wrestle?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「微妙にわからんが……ぶっちゃけ、役立たず
　と？」
dialogues.en:
"I don't quite get it...... but I think you're saying I'm
useless?"
dialogues.text:
"I don't quite get it...... but I think you're saying I'm
useless?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、そんなところだ」
dialogues.en: "Something like that."
dialogues.text: "Something like that."

dialogues.jp:
相変わらずのバカと、相変わらずにおバカな会
話を交わしつつ、通学路を進む。
dialogues.en:
I keep walking along the road to school, with an
ever-fatuous friend talking fatuously.
dialogues.text:
I keep walking along the road to school, with an
ever-fatuous friend talking fatuously.

dialogues.jp:
まだ校舎は見えない。……というか、杉並も暇
だな。ずいぶんと、俺の家の方に来ていたらし
い。
dialogues.en:
It'll take a while to get to school. He must have been bored
or something, because he came so far toward my house.
dialogues.text:
It'll take a while to get to school. He must have been bored
or something, because he came so far toward my house.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だが、まあ、心配するな。見よ、この日本晴
　れ！」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, don't you worry. Look at the beautiful sky!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, don't you worry. Look at the beautiful sky!"

dialogues.jp:
ずばっと空を指差す。つられて見上げると桜で
切り取られた真っ青な空が広がっていた。
dialogues.en:
He points his finger at the sky. I look up and see the clear
blue sky, surrounded by cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
He points his finger at the sky. I look up and see the clear
blue sky, surrounded by cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「今は春。そして、春と言えばなんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"It's spring time, and what comes to your mind when I say
spring?"
dialogues.text:
"It's spring time, and what comes to your mind when I say
spring?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……花粉症か？」
dialogues.en: "......Pollen allergy?"
dialogues.text: "......Pollen allergy?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「違うっ！」
dialogues.en: "Wrong!"
dialogues.text: "Wrong!"

dialogues.jp:
言い終わらないうちに、思い切り否定された。
……にゃろう。
dialogues.en: Before I finish my sentence, he's denied my answer... Crap.
dialogues.text: Before I finish my sentence, he's denied my answer... Crap.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「出会いだ！」
dialogues.en: "An encounter!"
dialogues.text: "An encounter!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "An encounter......?"
dialogues.text: "An encounter......?"

dialogues.jp: 思い切り｛うさん／胡散｝臭い視線を杉並に投げつける。
dialogues.en: I give him as shifty a look as I can.
dialogues.text: I give him as shifty a look as I can.

dialogues.jp: 「その１。通学途中、美少女転校生とぶつかる」
dialogues.en:
"Case 1. On the way to school, I run into a beautiful
transfer student."
dialogues.text:
"Case 1. On the way to school, I run into a beautiful
transfer student."

dialogues.jp:
「その２。７年前に別れたいとこと、深い雪に
　覆われた街にて再会」
dialogues.en:
"Case 2. In a city covered by snow, I meet up again with my
cousin whom I haven't seen for 7 years."
dialogues.text:
"Case 2. In a city covered by snow, I meet up again with my
cousin whom I haven't seen for 7 years."

dialogues.jp:
「その３。ボーリング玉のような、でっかいお
　むすびを食べてると、不思議な少女が話しか
　けてきた」
dialogues.en:
"Case 3. When I'm eating a big rice ball as big as a bowling
ball, a weird girl comes to talk to me."
dialogues.text:
"Case 3. When I'm eating a big rice ball as big as a bowling
ball, a weird girl comes to talk to me."

dialogues.jp:
「ひとつ訊くが、そんな出来事が現実にほんと
　にあるとでも？」
dialogues.en: "Do you really think those things will happen in real life?"
dialogues.text: "Do you really think those things will happen in real life?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何なんだ、その局地的な出会いは。もっと普
　通の出会いは出てこないのか？　お前は」
dialogues.en:
"What the hell are those extreme encounters? Can't you come
up with ones that're a little more normal?"
dialogues.text:
"What the hell are those extreme encounters? Can't you come
up with ones that're a little more normal?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「春だぞ？　新しい学年、新しいクラスだぞ？
　新しい出会いは｛ひつじょう／必定｝だろう」
dialogues.en:
"It's spring, man. We're in a new grade and we have new
classes. We're meant to meet new people."
dialogues.text:
"It's spring, man. We're in a new grade and we have new
classes. We're meant to meet new people."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そんなもんかね」
dialogues.en: "......I don't quite agree with you, but all right."
dialogues.text: "......I don't quite agree with you, but all right."

dialogues.jp:
そうこう言っているうちに、いつもの校舎が見
えてくる。
dialogues.en: Our school finally comes into my sight.
dialogues.text: Our school finally comes into my sight.

dialogues.jp:
通い慣れた道。通い慣れた風見学園。新しい出
会い、ねえ……。
dialogues.en:
The familiar road to the familiar Kazami Academy. Meet new
people, huh......?
dialogues.text:
The familiar road to the familiar Kazami Academy. Meet new
people, huh......?

dialogues.jp:
「そういやさ。この初音島って金持ちっつうか、
　上流階級の人間は住んでんのかな？」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, do you know if there are any upper-class rich
people living on Hatsune Island?"
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, do you know if there are any upper-class rich
people living on Hatsune Island?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何だ、そのアナクロな単語は？　お前は昭和
　の亡霊か？」
dialogues.en:
"Why are you using words like 'upper-class'? What era were
you born in?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you using words like 'upper-class'? What era were
you born in?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、昭和生まれではあるが」
dialogues.en: "......Well, the same era you were born in, I guess."
dialogues.text: "......Well, the same era you were born in, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ……上流か下流かは知らんが、水越眞子
　の家は、あれは金持ちらしいな」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm...... I'm not sure if they're upper or lower class, but
I heard that Mako Mizukoshi is rich."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm...... I'm not sure if they're upper or lower class, but
I heard that Mako Mizukoshi is rich."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、萌先輩の家な。……いや、あれは萌先
　輩じゃなかったしな……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Moe-sempai's family... But she wasn't Moe-sempai..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Moe-sempai's family... But she wasn't Moe-sempai..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あれっ？　お前、いったい何の話をしてる？
　もしや、上流階級のお嬢様との出会いでもあっ
　たか？」
dialogues.en:
"She wasn't Moe?? What the hell are you talking about? Are
you saying you met a princess of the upper class?"
dialogues.text:
"She wasn't Moe?? What the hell are you talking about? Are
you saying you met a princess of the upper class?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どこの世界に、そんないかがわしい出会いが
　転がってるんだっての」
dialogues.en:
"Where in this world would we find that kind of shady
encounter?"
dialogues.text:
"Where in this world would we find that kind of shady
encounter?"

dialogues.jp:
くっくっと苦笑しつつ、俺は杉並の前に足を進
めたのだった。
dialogues.en: I give a wry grin and keep walking in front of Suginami.
dialogues.text: I give a wry grin and keep walking in front of Suginami.

dialogues.jp: ◆春の出会い？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Suginami◆
dialogues.text: ◆Suginami◆

dialogues.jp: 登校途中に杉並と出会った。

音夢がいなくなったので、寂しがっているかと
思って待っていたらしいが、大きなお世話とい
うやつだ。
dialogues.en: I'm surprised by a sudden encounter.
dialogues.text: I'm surprised by a sudden encounter.

dialogues.jp:
二人で「春といえば出会いだろ」とかなんとか
相変わらず益体もない事を話しながら、学園に
向かったのだった。
dialogues.en: "I'm glad to know that you're so happy to see me!"
dialogues.text: "I'm glad to know that you're so happy to see me!"
